Press Releases
25007061On November 27, 2025, at approximately 1:08 a.m., the Whittier Police Departmentresponded to a report of a stabbing at a residence on Alpine Meadows in Girdwood. The         Jordancaller, C.B., reported that his mother had been assaulted and stabbed by herboyfriend,        Mattingley, who fled the scene prior to officer arrival.WPD officers located the victim inside the home with a serious arm injury and providedemergency medical care before she was transported to a hospital by paramedics. Evidenceat the scene indicated a violent assault. A knife believed to be used by the suspect wasrecovered. APD officers responded to an agency assist and located Mattingley on the SewardHighway North of Girdwood, where he was taken into custody without incident andremanded to the Anchorage Jail.Assault in the 2nd                     Assault in the 4th
